description: Y Combinator scraper Pro — full directory + advanced filters and derived fields.

batch.description: Filter by YC batch code. 'any' returns every batch. Codes: S=Summer, W=Winter, F=Fall followed by two-digit year (e.g. S24 = Summer 2024).
batch.title: Batch

companySlugs.description: Direct YC company slugs (e.g. ['airbnb','stripe']). Bypasses search and fetches each profile directly.
companySlugs.title: Company Slugs (Pro)

companyUrls.description: Direct YC company profile URLs (e.g. https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/airbnb). Bypasses search and fetches each profile directly.
companyUrls.title: Company URLs (Pro)

directoryUrl.description: Y Combinator company directory URL. Default scrapes the full directory. You can paste a filtered URL (e.g. https://www.ycombinator.com/companies?batch=S24&industry=AI).
directoryUrl.title: Directory URL

foundedAfterYear.description: Drop companies founded before this year (inclusive).
foundedAfterYear.title: Founded after year (Pro)

foundedBeforeYear.description: Drop companies founded after this year (inclusive).
foundedBeforeYear.title: Founded before year (Pro)

highlightBlackFounders.description: If true, only return companies flagged as having Black founders.
highlightBlackFounders.title: Highlight: Black Founders

highlightHispanicFounders.description: If true, only return companies flagged as having Hispanic / Latino founders.
highlightHispanicFounders.title: Highlight: Hispanic / Latino Founders

highlightWomenFounders.description: If true, only return companies flagged as having women founders.
highlightWomenFounders.title: Highlight: Women Founders

hiringOnly.description: Only emit companies with at least 1 open job posting.
hiringOnly.title: Hiring only (Pro)

industry.description: Filter by industry (e.g. 'B2B', 'Consumer', 'Fintech', 'Healthcare', 'Industrials', 'Real Estate and Construction'). Case-sensitive, exact match against YC's industry facets.
industry.title: Industry

maxItems.description: Maximum number of companies to return.
maxItems.title: Max Items

query.description: Optional free-text query. When set, filters the directory using the ?q=<query> Algolia search (matches name, description, tags).
query.title: Search Query

regions.description: Optional region filter (case-insensitive substring match against the company's location). Example: ["San Francisco", "New York"].
regions.title: Regions

requireFounderSocial.description: Only emit companies where at least one founder has a LinkedIn, Twitter, or GitHub URL.
requireFounderSocial.title: Require founder social (Pro)

scrapeFounders.description: Include each company's founders (name, title, bio, LinkedIn, Twitter, previousCompanies). Requires an extra detail-page fetch per company.
scrapeFounders.title: Scrape Founders

scrapeOpenJobs.description: Include each company's open job postings (title, URL, applyUrl, location, salary, equity, skills, visa, remoteFriendly).
scrapeOpenJobs.title: Scrape Open Jobs

status.description: Filter by company operating status. 'any' returns all statuses.
status.title: Status

tags.description: Optional tag filter (case-insensitive). Matched against industry, subIndustry and any tag arrays Algolia returns. Example: ["B2B", "Fintech"].
tags.title: Tags

teamSizeMax.description: Drop companies with more than N employees.
teamSizeMax.title: Max team size (Pro)

teamSizeMin.description: Drop companies with fewer than N employees.
teamSizeMin.title: Min team size (Pro)

title: Y Combinator Scraper Pro Input
